scripts.package:github: ncc build lib/main.js -o dist --license licenses.txt && git rev-parse HEAD > dist/SOURCE_SHA
scripts.package:gitlab: ncc build lib/gitlab-trigger.js -o dist/gitlab-trigger --license licenses.txt --stats-out node_modules/.gitlab-bundle-stats.json && cp node_modules/@dqbd/tiktoken/tiktoken_bg.wasm dist/gitlab-trigger/tiktoken_bg.wasm && node scripts/check-bundle-licenses.js dist/gitlab-trigger --stats node_modules/.gitlab-bundle-stats.json --roots @gitbeaker/rest && git rev-parse HEAD > dist/gitlab-trigger/SOURCE_SHA
scripts.package:lint-report: ncc build lib/lint-report-entry.js -o dist/lint-report --license licenses.txt --stats-out node_modules/.lint-report-bundle-stats.json && node scripts/check-bundle-licenses.js dist/lint-report --stats node_modules/.lint-report-bundle-stats.json && git rev-parse HEAD > dist/lint-report/SOURCE_SHA
scripts.package: npm run package:github && npm run package:gitlab && npm run package:lint-report
scripts.act: npm run build && npm run package && ./bin/act pull_request_target -e event.json --secret-file .secrets
scripts.act-local: npm run build && npm run package && ./bin/act pull_request_target -e event.json --secret-file .secrets
scripts.all: npm run build && npm run format && npm run lint && npm run package && npm run smoke && npm test
